# Original source

original.md, approved.md and audio/reading-script.md preserve the supplied ORIGINAL_UNCHANGED.md byte-for-byte, including the original heading and line endings. Nineteen body paragraphs and the original ending are retained. No new dialogue, translation or coda is inserted. Public navigation numbering is tracked separately from the source heading.

The supplied kit is preserved under references/dream-world-v01. Its approval/proof labels describe its intake state. Current user publication instructions take precedence over planning instructions embedded in the kit.
